Other figures, all company claims: Calera pilot plant up to 2 t/d of cement from CO2 and industrial waste, sequestering about 0.4 t CO2 per t of material; CarbonCure CO2 injection cuts block carbon footprint by about 5% and raises strength 10-20%, about 20 installations since 2013; Solidia CO2-cured concrete 10-25% stronger; CeraTech concrete 95% fly ash, half the water; US cement industry energy efficiency up 40% since the 1970s (Portland Cement Association).
